title: Garmin Run Asia Series Indonesia 2026 Review: ICE BSD Tech-Brand 21K
seo_title: Garmin Run Asia Indonesia 2026 Review | ICE BSD Race
meta_description: The Garmin Run Asia Series 2026 Indonesia: September 20 at ICE BSD. 21K, 10K, 5K from Garmin. Registration pending.
dek: Set for 20 September 2026 at ICE BSD in BSD City, this Garmin-branded run offers three distances. A tech-brand Indonesian race at the country's premier exhibition venue.
verdict: Garmin Run Asia Series Indonesia brings the global GPS-watch brand's running series to ICE BSD — Indonesia's largest exhibition centre in the planned BSD City satellite town. Three distances (21K, 10K, 5K). Garmin's brand presence typically means tech-enhanced race features and premium merchandise. Registration isn't open yet, but for Indonesian runners wanting a Garmin-branded race at a modern, well-venued location, this is worth tracking.
